What happens to my WhatsApp when I die?

Short answer: WhatsApp doesn't memorialise accounts or offer a legacy contact. Accounts are generally deleted after 365 days without connecting to WhatsApp. Chats and media saved on the person's phone stay there until the app is removed, so the phone itself is usually the only way family can keep messages. Recipients keep their own copies of messages.

Key facts

  • No memorialisation or legacy contact
  • Inactive accounts deleted after 365 days
  • Local chats stay on the device until WhatsApp is removed
  • Deletion can't be undone or restored

How do I prepare my WhatsApp account?

  1. Back up your chats now (Settings → Chats → Chat backup) so a copy exists on Google Drive or iCloud.
  2. Export important chats you'd want family to have.
  3. Record your phone passcode in a password manager with emergency access.
  4. After a death, keep the phone safe and charged; don't uninstall WhatsApp if you want to keep local chats.

Read the official policy ↗

What documents do heirs need?

  • To keep chats: access to the unlocked phone (the passcode)

How long does it take?

Generally 365 days of inactivity before automatic deletion. A deliberate account deletion can take up to 90 days to complete.

What can't be recovered?

  • Chats, media and backups from a deleted account: WhatsApp says it can't restore or transfer them
  • Contacts saved to the WhatsApp account are deleted with it

Frequently asked questions

What happens to my WhatsApp when I die?

WhatsApp doesn't memorialise accounts or offer a legacy contact. Accounts are generally deleted after 365 days without connecting to WhatsApp. Chats and media saved on the person's phone stay there until the app is removed, so the phone itself is usually the only way family can keep messages. Recipients keep their own copies of messages.

Can family read a dead person's WhatsApp messages?

Only from the person's own unlocked phone or a backup they can open. WhatsApp doesn't provide access.

Does a WhatsApp account delete itself?

Generally yes, after 365 days of inactivity.

Do other people keep my messages?

Yes. Deleting an account doesn't remove other users' copies of messages you sent them.
